name: Wilmington
housing: Wilmington's rentals are largely brick row houses and older apartment buildings, plus newer apartments on the Riverfront.

tenantHelp.name: Community Legal Aid Society (CLASI)
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for tenants, including subsidized housing and evictions

climate: Test both the heating and the air conditioning; winters are cold and summers are humid.
fact: Wilmington requires rental owners who live outside New Castle County to hire a local property manager.
